question: By whose agency and will was the yoginī Icchā extended up to Māyā?
premises: The action reaches up to Māyā by supreme will
inference: The yoginī Icchā was established up to Māyā by the siddhas through supreme will.
uncertainties: The exact verbal action is implicit and not stated
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, by the siddhas and by supreme will, extends up to Māyā.
